extractions.value: Patient had three paraneoplastic neurological presentations caused by anti-amphiphysin antibodies: SPS, cervical TM, and central DI from hypothalamitis. DI spontaneously resolved after immunotherapy. She left against medical advice without treating her breast cancer.
